verses.en: And he went out from thence, and came into his own country; and his disciples follow him.
verses.pt: Jesus partiu-se dali, veio à sua terra, e seus discípulos o seguiram.
verses.en_web: He went out from there. He came into his own country, and his disciples followed him.
verses.en_bbe: And he went away from there, and came into his country; and his disciples went with him.

verses.en: And when the sabbath day was come, he began to teach in the synagogue: and many hearing him were astonished, saying, From whence hath this man these things? and what wisdom is this which is given unto him, that even such mighty works are wrought by his hands?
verses.pt: E chegando o sábado, começou a ensinar na sinagoga; e muitos, quando o ouviram, espantavam-se, dizendo: De onde lhe vem estas coisas? E que sabedoria é esta que lhe foi dada? E tais maravilhas feitas por suas mãos?
verses.en_web: When the Sabbath had come, he began to teach in the synagogue, and many hearing him were astonished, saying, “Where did this man get these things?” and, “What is the wisdom that is given to this man, that such mighty works come about by his hands?
verses.en_bbe: And when the Sabbath day had come, he was teaching in the Synagogue; and a number of people hearing him were surprised, saying, From where did this man get these things? and, What is the wisdom given to this man, and what are these works of power done by his hands?

verses.en: Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary, the brother of James, and Joses, and of Juda, and Simon? and are not his sisters here with us? And they were offended at him.
verses.pt: Não é este o carpinteiro, filho de Maria, e irmão de Tiago, de José, de Judas, e de Simão? E não estão aqui as suas irmãs conosco? E ofenderam-se nele.
verses.en_web: Isn’t this the carpenter, the son of Mary, and brother of James, Joses, Judah, and Simon? Aren’t his sisters here with us?” They were offended at him.
verses.en_bbe: Is not this the woodworker, the son of Mary, and brother of James and Joses and Judas and Simon? and are not his sisters here with us? And they were bitter against him.

verses.en: But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, but in his own country, and among his own kin, and in his own house.
verses.pt: E Jesus lhes dizia: Todo profeta tem honra, menos em sua terra, entre os parentes, e em sua própria casa.
verses.en_web: Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country, and among his own relatives, and in his own house.”
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus said to them, A prophet is nowhere without honour, but in his country, and among his relations, and in his family.

verses.en: And he could there do no mighty work, save that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk, and healed them.
verses.pt: Ele não pôde ali fazer milagre algum, a não ser somente para uns poucos enfermos, sobre os quais pôs as mãos e os curou.
verses.en_web: He could do no mighty work there, except that he laid his hands on a few sick people, and healed them.
verses.en_bbe: And he was unable to do any work of power there, but only to put his hands on one or two persons who were ill, and make them well.

verses.en: And he marvelled because of their unbelief. And he went round about the villages, teaching.
verses.pt: E ficou admirado da incredulidade deles. Ele percorreu as aldeias do redor, ensinando.
verses.en_web: He marveled because of their unbelief. He went around the villages teaching.
verses.en_bbe: And he was greatly surprised because they had no faith. And he went about the country places teaching.

verses.en: And he called unto him the twelve, and began to send them forth by two and two; and gave them power over unclean spirits;
verses.pt: E chamou a si os doze, e começou a enviar de dois em dois; e deu-lhes poder sobre os espíritos imundos.
verses.en_web: He called to himself the twelve, and began to send them out two by two; and he gave them authority over the unclean spirits.
verses.en_bbe: And he gave orders to the twelve, and sent them out two by two; and he gave them authority over the unclean spirits;

verses.en: And commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, save a staff only; no scrip, no bread, no money in their purse:
verses.pt: E mandou-lhes que não tomassem nada para o caminho, a não ser somente um bordão; nem bolsa, nem pão, nem dinheiro no cinto;
verses.en_web: He commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, except a staff only: no bread, no wallet, no money in their purse,
verses.en_bbe: And he said that they were to take nothing for their journey, but a stick only; no bread, no bag, no money in their pockets;

verses.en: But be shod with sandals; and not put on two coats.
verses.pt: mas que calçassem sandálias, e não se vestissem de duas túnicas.
verses.en_web: but to wear sandals, and not put on two tunics.
verses.en_bbe: They were to go with common shoes on their feet, and not to take two coats.

verses.en: And he said unto them, In what place soever ye enter into an house, there abide till ye depart from that place.
verses.pt: E dizia-lhes: Onde quer que entrardes em alguma casa, ficai ali até que dali saiais.
verses.en_web: He said to them, “Wherever you enter into a house, stay there until you depart from there.
verses.en_bbe: And he said to them, Wherever you go into a house, make that your resting-place till you go away.

verses.en: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear you, when ye depart thence, shake off the dust under your feet for a testimony against them. Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.
verses.pt: E todos os que não vos receberem, nem vos ouvirem, quando sairdes dali, sacudi o pó que estiver debaixo de vossos pés, em testemunho contra eles Em verdade vos digo, que mais tolerável será a os de Sodoma ou Gomorra no dia do juízo, do que a os d aquela cidade.
verses.en_web: Whoever will not receive you nor hear you, as you depart from there, shake off the dust that is under your feet for a testimony against them. Assuredly, I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city!”
verses.en_bbe: And whatever place will not take you in and will not give ear to you, when you go away, put off the dust from your feet as a witness against them.

verses.en: And they went out, and preached that men should repent.
verses.pt: Eles, então, se foram, e pregaram que as pessoas se arrependessem.
verses.en_web: They went out and preached that people should repent.
verses.en_bbe: And they went out, preaching the need for a change of heart in men.

verses.en: And they cast out many devils, and anointed with oil many that were sick, and healed them.
verses.pt: Eles expulsaram muitos demônios, e a muitos enfermos ungiram com azeite, e os curaram.
verses.en_web: They cast out many demons, and anointed many with oil who were sick, and healed them.
verses.en_bbe: And they sent out a number of evil spirits, and put oil on a great number who were ill, and made them well.

verses.en: And king Herod heard of him; (for his name was spread abroad:) and he said, That John the Baptist was risen from the dead, and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.
verses.pt: O rei Herodes ouviu falar disso (porque o nome de Jesus já era notório). E dizia: João Batista ressuscitou dos mortos, e por isso estas maravilhas operam nele.
verses.en_web: King Herod heard this, for his name had become known, and he said, “John the Baptizer has risen from the dead, and therefore these powers are at work in him.”
verses.en_bbe: And king Herod had news of him, because his name was on the lips of all; and he said, John the Baptist has come back from the dead, and for this reason these powers are working in him.

verses.en: Others said, That it is Elias. And others said, That it is a prophet, or as one of the prophets.
verses.pt: Outros diziam: É Elias; e outros diziam: É profeta, ou como algum dos profetas.
verses.en_web: But others said, “He is Elijah.” Others said, “He is a prophet, or like one of the prophets.”
verses.en_bbe: But others said, It is Elijah. And others said, It is a prophet, even like one of the prophets.

verses.en: But when Herod heard thereof, he said, It is John, whom I beheaded: he is risen from the dead.
verses.pt: Quando, porém, Herodes ouviu falar disso, falou: Ele é João, de quem cortei a cabeça. Ele ressuscitou dos mortos.
verses.en_web: But Herod, when he heard this, said, “This is John, whom I beheaded. He has risen from the dead.”
verses.en_bbe: But Herod, when he had news of it, said, John, whom I put to death, has come back from the dead.

verses.en: For Herod himself had sent forth and laid hold upon John, and bound him in prison for Herodias’ sake, his brother Philip’s wife: for he had married her.
verses.pt: Pois o próprio Herodes havia mandado prender João, e acorrentá-lo na prisão, por causa de Herodias, mulher do seu irmão Filipe, porque havia se casado com ela.
verses.en_web: For Herod himself had sent out and arrested John, and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife, for he had married her.
verses.en_bbe: For Herod himself had sent men out to take John and put him in prison, because of Herodias, his brother Philip's wife, whom he had taken for himself.

verses.en: For John had said unto Herod, It is not lawful for thee to have thy brother’s wife.
verses.pt: Pois João dizia a Herodes: Não te é lícito possuir a mulher do teu irmão.
verses.en_web: For John said to Herod, “It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife.”
verses.en_bbe: For John said to Herod, It is wrong for you to have your brother's wife.

verses.en: Therefore Herodias had a quarrel against him, and would have killed him; but she could not:
verses.pt: Assim Herodias o odiava, e queria matá-lo, mas não podia,
verses.en_web: Herodias set herself against him, and desired to kill him, but she couldn’t,
verses.en_bbe: And Herodias was bitter against him, desiring to put him to death; but she was not able;

verses.en: For Herod feared John, knowing that he was a just man and an holy, and observed him; and when he heard him, he did many things, and heard him gladly.
verses.pt: pois Herodes temia João, sabendo que era um homem justo e santo, e o estimava. E quando o ouvia, fazia muitas coisas, o ouvia de boa vontade.
verses.en_web: for Herod feared John, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man, and kept him safe. When he heard him, he did many things, and he heard him gladly.
verses.en_bbe: For Herod was in fear of John, being conscious that he was an upright and holy man, and kept him safe. And hearing him, he was much troubled; and he gave ear to him gladly.

verses.en: And when a convenient day was come, that Herod on his birthday made a supper to his lords, high captains, and chief estates of Galilee;
verses.pt: Mas veio um dia oportuno, em que Herodes, no dia do seu aniversário, dava uma ceia aos grandes de sua corte, aos comandantes militares, e aos principais da Galileia.
verses.en_web: Then a convenient day came, that Herod on his birthday made a supper for his nobles, the high officers, and the chief men of Galilee.
verses.en_bbe: And the chance came when Herod on his birthday gave a feast to his lords, and the high captains, and the chief men of Galilee;

verses.en: And when the daughter of the said Herodias came in, and danced, and pleased Herod and them that sat with him, the king said unto the damsel, Ask of me whatsoever thou wilt, and I will give it thee.
verses.pt: Então a filha dessa Herodias entrou dançando, e agradou a Herodes e aos que estavam sentados com ele. O rei disse à garota: Pede-me quanto quiseres, que eu darei a ti.
verses.en_web: When the daughter of Herodias herself came in and danced, she pleased Herod and those sitting with him. The king said to the young lady, “Ask me whatever you want, and I will give it to you.”
verses.en_bbe: And when the daughter of Herodias herself came in and did a dance, Herod and those who were at table with him were pleased with her; and the king said to the girl, Make a request for anything and I will give it you.

verses.en: And he sware unto her, Whatsoever thou shalt ask of me, I will give it thee, unto the half of my kingdom.
verses.pt: E jurou a ela: Tudo o que me pedirdes te darei, até a metade do meu reino.
verses.en_web: He swore to her, “Whatever you shall ask of me, I will give you, up to half of my kingdom.”
verses.en_bbe: And he took an oath, saying to her, Whatever is your desire I will give it to you, even half of my kingdom.

verses.en: And she went forth, and said unto her mother, What shall I ask? And she said, The head of John the Baptist.
verses.pt: Então ela saiu, e perguntou à sua mãe: Que pedirei? E ela respondeu: A cabeça de João Batista.
verses.en_web: She went out, and said to her mother, “What shall I ask?” She said, “The head of John the Baptizer.”
verses.en_bbe: And she went out and said to her mother, What is my request to be? And she said, The head of John the Baptist.

verses.en: And she came in straightway with haste unto the king, and asked, saying, I will that thou give me by and by in a charger the head of John the Baptist.
verses.pt: E entrando ela logo apressadamente ao rei, pediu, dizendo: Quero que imediatamente me dês num prato a cabeça de João Batista.
verses.en_web: She came in immediately with haste to the king, and asked, “I want you to give me right now the head of John the Baptizer on a platter.”
verses.en_bbe: And she came in quickly to the king, and said, My desire is that you give me straight away on a plate the head of John the Baptist.

verses.en: And the king was exceeding sorry; yet for his oath’s sake, and for their sakes which sat with him, he would not reject her.
verses.pt: E o rei entristeceu-se muito; mas, por causa dos juramentos, e dos que estavam juntamente à mesa, não quis recusar a ela.
verses.en_web: The king was exceedingly sorry, but for the sake of his oaths, and of his dinner guests, he didn’t wish to refuse her.
verses.en_bbe: And the king was very sad; but because of his oaths, and those who were with him at table, he would not say 'No' to her.

verses.en: And immediately the king sent an executioner, and commanded his head to be brought: and he went and beheaded him in the prison,
verses.pt: Então logo o rei enviou o executor com a ordem de trazer ali sua cabeça. Ele, foi, e o decapitou na prisão.
verses.en_web: Immediately the king sent out a soldier of his guard, and commanded to bring John’s head, and he went and beheaded him in the prison,
verses.en_bbe: And straight away the king sent out one of his armed men, and gave him an order to come back with the head: and he went and took off John's head in prison,

verses.en: And brought his head in a charger, and gave it to the damsel: and the damsel gave it to her mother.
verses.pt: Em seguida, trouxe a sua cabeça num prato, e o deu à garota; e a garota a deu à sua mãe.
verses.en_web: and brought his head on a platter, and gave it to the young lady; and the young lady gave it to her mother.
verses.en_bbe: And came back with the head on a plate, and gave it to the girl; and the girl gave it to her mother.

verses.en: And when his disciples heard of it, they came and took up his corpse, and laid it in a tomb.
verses.pt: Quando os discípulos dele ouviram isso, vieram, pegaram o seu cadáver, e o puseram num sepulcro.
verses.en_web: When his disciples heard this, they came and took up his corpse, and laid it in a tomb.
verses.en_bbe: And when his disciples had news of it, they came and took up his body, and put it in its last resting-place.

verses.en: And the apostles gathered themselves together unto Jesus, and told him all things, both what they had done, and what they had taught.
verses.pt: Os apóstolos juntaram-se de volta a Jesus, e contaram-lhe tudo, tanto o que haviam feito, como o que haviam ensinado.
verses.en_web: The apostles gathered themselves together to Jesus, and they told him all things, whatever they had done, and whatever they had taught.
verses.en_bbe: And the twelve came together to Jesus; and they gave him an account of all the things they had done, and all they had been teaching.

verses.en: And he said unto them, Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while: for there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
verses.pt: E ele lhes disse: Vinde vós à parte a um lugar deserto, e descansai um pouco; pois havia muitos que iam e vinham, e não tinham tempo para comer.
verses.en_web: He said to them, “You come apart into a deserted place, and rest awhile.” For there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
verses.en_bbe: And he said to them, Come away by yourselves to a quiet place, and take a rest for a time. Because there were a great number coming and going, and they had no time even for food.

verses.en: And they departed into a desert place by ship privately.
verses.pt: E foram-se num barco a um lugar deserto à parte.
verses.en_web: They went away in the boat to a deserted place by themselves.
verses.en_bbe: And they went away in the boat to a waste place by themselves.

verses.en: And the people saw them departing, and many knew him, and ran afoot thither out of all cities, and outwent them, and came together unto him.
verses.pt: Mas as multidões os viram ir, e muitos o reconheceram. Então correram para lá a pé de todas as cidades, chegaram antes deles, e vieram para perto dele.
verses.en_web: They saw them going, and many recognized him and ran there on foot from all the cities. They arrived before them and came together to him.
verses.en_bbe: And the people saw them going, and a number of them, having knowledge who they were, went running there together on foot from all the towns, and got there before them.

verses.en: And Jesus, when he came out, saw much people, and was moved with compassion toward them, because they were as sheep not having a shepherd: and he began to teach them many things.
verses.pt: Quando Jesus saiu do barco, viu uma grande multidão, e teve compaixão deles porque eram como ovelhas que não têm pastor. Assim, começou a lhes ensinar muitas coisas.
verses.en_web: Jesus came out, saw a great multitude, and he had compassion on them, because they were like sheep without a shepherd, and he began to teach them many things.
verses.en_bbe: And he got out, and saw a great mass of people, and he had pity on them, because they were like sheep without a keeper: and he gave them teaching about a number of things.

verses.en: And when the day was now far spent, his disciples came unto him, and said, This is a desert place, and now the time is far passed:
verses.pt: E quando já era tarde, os seus discípulos vieram a ele, e disseram: O lugar é deserto, e a hora já é tarde.
verses.en_web: When it was late in the day, his disciples came to him, and said, “This place is deserted, and it is late in the day.
verses.en_bbe: And at the end of the day, his disciples came to him and said, This place is waste land, and it is late:

verses.en: Send them away, that they may go into the country round about, and into the villages, and buy themselves bread: for they have nothing to eat.
verses.pt: Despede-os, para eles irem aos campos e aldeias circunvizinhos, e comprarem pão para si; pois não têm o que comer.
verses.en_web: Send them away, that they may go into the surrounding country and villages, and buy themselves bread, for they have nothing to eat.”
verses.en_bbe: Send them away, so that they may go into the country and small towns round about, and get some food for themselves.

verses.en: He answered and said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they say unto him, Shall we go and buy two hundred pennyworth of bread, and give them to eat?
verses.pt: Mas ele respondeu: Dai-lhes vós mesmos de comer. E eles lhe responderam: Iremos, e compraremos duzentos denários de pão, para lhes darmos de comer?
verses.en_web: But he answered them, “You give them something to eat.” They asked him, “Shall we go and buy two hundred denarii worth of bread, and give them something to eat?”
verses.en_bbe: But he said to them in answer, Give them food yourselves. And they said to him, Are we to go and get bread for two hundred pence, and give it to them?

verses.en: He saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? go and see. And when they knew, they say, Five, and two fishes.
verses.pt: E ele lhes disse: Quantos pães tendes? Ide ver. Quando souberam, disseram: Cinco, e dois peixes.
verses.en_web: He said to them, “How many loaves do you have? Go see.” When they knew, they said, “Five, and two fish.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to them, How much bread have you? go and see. And when they had seen, they said, Five cakes of bread and two fishes.

verses.en: And he commanded them to make all sit down by companies upon the green grass.
verses.pt: E mandou-lhes que fizessem sentar a todos em grupos sobre a grama verde.
verses.en_web: He commanded them that everyone should sit down in groups on the green grass.
verses.en_bbe: And he made them all be seated in groups on the green grass.

verses.en: And they sat down in ranks, by hundreds, and by fifties.
verses.pt: E sentaram-se repartidos de cem em cem, e de cinquenta em cinquenta.
verses.en_web: They sat down in ranks, by hundreds and by fifties.
verses.en_bbe: And they were placed in groups, by hundreds and by fifties.

verses.en: And when he had taken the five loaves and the two fishes, he looked up to heaven, and blessed, and brake the loaves, and gave them to his disciples to set before them; and the two fishes divided he among them all.
verses.pt: Ele tomou os cinco pães e os dois peixes, levantou os olhos ao céu, abençoou, e partiu os pães, e os deu aos seus discípulos, para que os pusessem diante deles. E os dois peixes repartiu com todos.
verses.en_web: He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, he blessed and broke the loaves, and he gave to his disciples to set before them, and he divided the two fish among them all.
verses.en_bbe: And he took the five cakes of bread and the two fishes and, looking up to heaven, he said words of blessing over them; and when the cakes were broken, he gave them to the disciples to put before the people; and he made division of the two fishes among them all.

verses.en: And they did all eat, and were filled.
verses.pt: Todos comeram e se saciaram.
verses.en_web: They all ate, and were filled.
verses.en_bbe: And they all took of the food and had enough.

verses.en: And they took up twelve baskets full of the fragments, and of the fishes.
verses.pt: E dos pedaços de pão e dos peixes levantaram doze cestos cheios.
verses.en_web: They took up twelve baskets full of broken pieces and also of the fish.
verses.en_bbe: And they took up twelve baskets full of the broken bits and of the fishes.

verses.en: And they that did eat of the loaves were about five thousand men.
verses.pt: Os que comeram os pães eram quase cinco mil homens.
verses.en_web: Those who ate the loaves were five thousand men.
verses.en_bbe: And those who took of the bread were five thousand men.

verses.en: And straightway he constrained his disciples to get into the ship, and to go to the other side before unto Bethsaida, while he sent away the people.
verses.pt: Logo depois, ordenou seus discípulos a subirem no barco, e ir adiante para o outro lado, em Betsaida, enquanto ele despedia a multidão.
verses.en_web: Immediately he made his disciples get into the boat, and to go ahead to the other side, to Bethsaida, while he himself sent the multitude away.
verses.en_bbe: And straight away he made his disciples get into the boat, and go before him to the other side to Beth-saida, while he himself sent the people away.

verses.en: And when he had sent them away, he departed into a mountain to pray.
verses.pt: E, depois de os despedir, foi ao monte para orar.
verses.en_web: After he had taken leave of them, he went up the mountain to pray.
verses.en_bbe: And after he had sent them away, he went up into a mountain for prayer.

verses.en: And when even was come, the ship was in the midst of the sea, and he alone on the land.
verses.pt: Ao anoitecer, o barco estava no meio do mar, e Jesus sozinho em terra.
verses.en_web: When evening had come, the boat was in the middle of the sea, and he was alone on the land.
verses.en_bbe: And by evening, the boat was in the middle of the sea, and he by himself on the land.

verses.en: And he saw them toiling in rowing; for the wind was contrary unto them: and about the fourth watch of the night he cometh unto them, walking upon the sea, and would have passed by them.
verses.pt: E viu que se cansavam muito remando, porque o vento lhes era contrário. Então, perto da quarta vigília da noite, veio a eles andando sobre o mar, e queria passar por eles.
verses.en_web: Seeing them distressed in rowing, for the wind was contrary to them, about the fourth watch of the night he came to them, walking on the sea, and he would have passed by them,
verses.en_bbe: And seeing that they had trouble in getting their boat through the water, because the wind was against them, about the fourth watch of the night he came to them, walking on the sea; and he would have gone past them;

verses.en: But when they saw him walking upon the sea, they supposed it had been a spirit, and cried out:
verses.pt: Mas quando eles o viram andando sobre o mar, pensaram que era uma fantasma, e gritaram,
verses.en_web: but they, when they saw him walking on the sea, supposed that it was a ghost, and cried out;
verses.en_bbe: But they, when they saw him walking on the sea, took him for a spirit, and gave a loud cry:

verses.en: For they all saw him, and were troubled. And immediately he talked with them, and saith unto them, Be of good cheer: it is I; be not afraid.
verses.pt: pois todos o viam, e ficaram perturbados. Então logo falou com eles, dizendo: Tende coragem! Sou eu, não tenhais medo.
verses.en_web: for they all saw him, and were troubled. But he immediately spoke with them, and said to them, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”
verses.en_bbe: For they all saw him, and were troubled. But straight away he said to them, Take heart, it is I, have no fear.

verses.en: And he went up unto them into the ship; and the wind ceased: and they were sore amazed in themselves beyond measure, and wondered.
verses.pt: E subiu a eles no barco, e o vento se aquietou. Eles ficaram muito espantados e maravilhados entre si,
verses.en_web: He got into the boat with them; and the wind ceased, and they were very amazed among themselves, and marveled;
verses.en_bbe: And he went to them into the boat, and the wind went down, and they were full of wonder in themselves;

verses.en: For they considered not the miracle of the loaves: for their heart was hardened.
verses.pt: pois não haviam entendido o que tinha acontecido com os pães, porque o coração deles estava endurecido.
verses.en_web: for they hadn’t understood about the loaves, but their hearts were hardened.
verses.en_bbe: For it was not clear to them about the bread; but their hearts were hard.

verses.en: And when they had passed over, they came into the land of Gennesaret, and drew to the shore.
verses.pt: Eles terminaram de atravessar o mar, chegaram à terra de Genesaré, e ali aportaram.
verses.en_web: When they had crossed over, they came to land at Gennesaret, and moored to the shore.
verses.en_bbe: And when they had gone across, they came to Gennesaret, and got their boat to land.

verses.en: And when they were come out of the ship, straightway they knew him,
verses.pt: Quando eles saíram do barco, logo as pessoas o reconheceram.
verses.en_web: When they had come out of the boat, immediately the people recognized him,
verses.en_bbe: And when they had got out of the boat, the people quickly had news of him,

verses.en: And ran through that whole region round about, and began to carry about in beds those that were sick, where they heard he was.
verses.pt: Então gente de toda a região em redor veio correndo, e começaram a trazer em camas os doentes, aonde quer que ouviam que ele estava.
verses.en_web: and ran around that whole region, and began to bring those who were sick, on their mats, to where they heard he was.
verses.en_bbe: And went running through all the country round about, and took on their beds those who were ill, to where it was said that he was.

verses.en: And whithersoever he entered, into villages, or cities, or country, they laid the sick in the streets, and besought him that they might touch if it were but the border of his garment: and as many as touched him were made whole.
verses.pt: E aonde quer que ele entrava, em povoados, cidades, ou aldeias, colocavam os enfermos nas praças, e rogavam-lhe que ao menos tocassem a borda de sua roupa; e todos os que o tocavam ficavam sarados.
verses.en_web: Wherever he entered, into villages, or into cities, or into the country, they laid the sick in the marketplaces, and begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment; and as many as touched him were made well.
verses.en_bbe: And wherever he went, into small towns, or great towns, or into the country, they took those who were ill into the market-places, requesting him that they might put their hands even on the edge of his robe: and all those who did so were made well.
